title: Display
info:
It is highly recommended to choose an OLED or TFT Screen.
ST7796 is more capable that ILI9488. ST7735 is well-supported.

name: GC9A01A (SPI 240x240 TFT)
info: Uses SPI Bus A Pins: SPIA_SCK & SPIA_MOSI

defines.comment: pin CS is attached to (255 = tied to GND)
pin RST is attached to (-1 = EN pin)
pin that controls brightness / backlight (255 = unused)
enable screen dimming (depends on brightness pin)
fixes display inversion quirk (very common)
rotates display 90° (width MUST equal height)

name: ST7735 (SPI TFT)
info:
Uses SPI Bus A Pins: SPIA_SCK & SPIA_MOSI
INITR_BLACKTAB, INITR_GREENTAB, INITR_REDTAB are 160x128
INITR_144GREENTAB is 128x128, INITR_MINI160x80 is 160x80

defines.comment: pin CS is attached to (255 = tied to GND)
pin that controls brightness / backlight (255 = unused)
enable screen dimming (depends on brightness pin)
fixes display inversion quirk (very common)
rotates display 90° (width MUST equal height so only INITR_144GREENTAB)

name: ST7789 (SPI TFT)
info:
Uses SPI Bus A Pins: SPIA_SCK & SPIA_MOSI
Default resolution: 320x240
Supported resolutions: 480x320, 320x240, 284x76, 240x240, 220x176, 160x128, 160x80, or 128x128
See https://www.instructables.com/Adding-CS-Pin-to-13-LCD/ if your display has no CS pin

override default height (240)
